settings.title: CUSTOM GYMNASTICS LEOTARD
settings.text:
Tailored for Excellence

Our custom leotards are designed to meet the high standards of both training and competition. Each piece is crafted to provide maximum comfort and flexibility, ensuring your athletes can perform their best.
Get a detailed catalog of our custom leotards via email or whatsapp. Choose your favorite designs to get a free physical sample of your personalized gymnastics leotard. It’s that easy!

settings.title: CREATE A TEAM VIBE WITH CUSTOM GYMNASTICS LEOTARD
settings.content: Unify your team, club, or academy with personalized gymnastics leotards from Ikaanya. Our leotards come in a wide range of sizes all the way from child, to youth, to adult sizes (XS to XL). Find leotards that are the perfect look – and fit – for the whole team.

settings.title: High-Quality Materials
settings.content: We use only the finest materials to ensure comfort and durability.

settings.title: Expert Craftsmanship
settings.content: Our team of skilled designers and craftsmen ensure each piece is perfect.

settings.title: Customer Satisfaction
settings.content: We prioritize your needs and work closely with you to bring your vision to life.

settings.title: Competitive Pricing
settings.content: Enjoy premium customization at competitive rates.

settings.testimonial: We received 300 uniforms with 2 different color shirts – from IKAANYA, after we previously sourced from, a major brand, we could not have been happier with the uniforms, the quality of the material, printing, and embroidery surpassed what we supplied before. Our players were also delighted as their smiles and pride in wearing their training kit made all the hard work worthwhile!
settings.author: Huw Harris

settings.testimonial: IKAANYA provided beautiful costumes for my Kathak studio, Aangik’s annual program. There were many costumes of different designs and colors for 125 participants across groups, with dancers ranging from the ages 6-60 years old. All my students inclusive of the audience were enchanted and even appreciated the costumes thoroughly. The color combinations and quality were splendid.
settings.author: Mousmi Chowdhuri

settings.testimonial: It’s not easy finding good-quality ballet leotards in India. I am happy that I found IKAANYA, who first sent me samples and worked with me to get exactly what I wanted in terms of colors, designs, and top-notch quality, all at good price points. The costumes are global-spec factory-made, giving consistent quality and sizes. I am now a repeat customer and bought hundreds of leotards and tights.
settings.author: Neha Sujhani
